acceptance: No create-github-app-token step uses app-id in either repository, and the deprecation warning is gone from their runs.
theseus infra setup delivers the review App client ID, and a re-run plans no change.
A review run, a gate run and a SQLGlot delivery run succeed after the switch.
description: actions/create-github-app-token deprecates the `app-id` input in favor of `client-id`. Uses on 2026-11-20: Theseus main .github/workflows/gate.yml:259 and :420 and review.yml:231, :535 and :547 (secrets.REVIEW_APP_ID); BenchBox develop .github/workflows/site-inputs.yml:131 (SITE_BRIDGE_APP_ID) and sqlglot-delivery.yml:239 and :298 (SQLGLOT_DELIVERY_APP_ID). Each App's client ID must be stored (secret or variable) before switching, and `theseus infra setup` should deliver the review App's client ID the same way it delivers REVIEW_APP_ID today. Changes to the review workflows are soundness paths and follow the review gate rules.
